name: Sapayoa
rangeDescription: Tropical central panama to colombia and far northwestern ecuador
description: A strange greenish bird with a limited distribution from Panama to northwest Ecuador. Dull olive overall, slightly brighter yellow on the throat and upper breast.

name: Buru Oriole
rangeDescription: Buru (southern moluccas)
description: A large gray-brown oriole with a straight, heavy bill. Main field mark is an ill-defined dark mask on the feathered face.

name: Caucasian Snowcock
rangeDescription: Rocky high-montane caucasus of southwestern russia, northern georgia, and northern azerbaijan
description: Large and heavily-built gamebird of the Caucasus Mountains. Grayish overall, with a whitish face and throat.

name: Japanese Cormorant
rangeDescription: Rocky seacoasts and islands of northeastern asia
description: A large dark cormorant of rocky marine shorelines, rarely recorded inland, unlike similar Great Cormorant, which is widespread inland. Similar to Great, but adult has more extensive white in the throat and in breeding plumage shows green (not bronze) sheen above.

name: European Red-rumped Swallow
rangeDescription: Iberian peninsula to northern africa, iran, afghanistan, and northwestern india
description: Brightly-colored swallow with a deeply forked tail, pale orangish rump, black squared-off undertail coverts, an incomplete orange collar, and faint streaking below. Juveniles average paler and lack extensive orangish tones; may resemble house-martins but note deeply forked tail.

name: White-capped Bunting
rangeDescription: Southern turkmenistan to northern afghanistan, northern pakistan and northwestern india
description: Male’s elegant black-and-white facial pattern is unique. Female is plain, streaky brown all over with faint white eye-ring, a weak hint of the male’s facial pattern, and a small white spot on the “ears”.

name: Black-faced Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Subtropical andes of southeastern peru (cusco and puno)
description: Long-tailed, sparrow-like bird found in humid habitats along the Andes. Has a dark gray face and upperparts, with dusky yellowish underparts and a rusty red crown.

name: Mountain Bluebird
rangeDescription: Western north america (alaska to central mexico); winters to baja california
description: Adult males are stunning: completely electric turquoise blue with limited white belly. Females are gray with blue wings and tail; some can show a rufous wash on breast.

name: Trilling Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Andes of northwestern peru to east-central bolivia (santa cruz)
description: Tiny, compact gray bird. Females are slightly duller, with brown lower sides and rump.

name: Western Red-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Senegambia to (mali) inner niger delta
description: Fairly small, slim, long-tailed hornbill. Note the red bill, dark eye with a ring of black skin, and heavily spotted back.

name: Southern Grosbeak-Canary
rangeDescription: Savanna of southern kenya and northeastern tanzania
description: A large seedeater with a very thick pinkish bill. Brownish-olive above and yellow below with streaking along the sides.
imageCreditName: Keith Valentine I Rockjumper Birding Tours

name: Biak Megapode
rangeDescription: Islands in cenderawasih bay (off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small, dark scrubfowl of forest and disturbed habitats on the Bay Islands where the only member of its family. Sooty gray plumage, bare red to gray face, slight crest at the back of the head, reddish legs, and yellowish bill.

name: Cinereous Finch
rangeDescription: Arid coastal northwestern peru (tumbes to la libertad)
description: Gray bird with a yellow bill and legs found in arid areas of northwestern Peru. Despite its name, it is currently placed in the tanager family, though its thick, stubby bill does give it a finch-like look.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Cinnamon-throated Hermit
rangeDescription: Eastern bolivia and adjacent southwestern brazil; northeastern brazil (maranhão to ceará)
description: Tiny hummingbird with a curved bill. Easily confused with other hermits, but note the cinnamon tinge to the underparts and the white-tipped central tail feathers.

name: Vega Gull
rangeDescription: Northeastern siberia; winters southward to china
description: A large, sturdy gull of East Asia. Adults have a fairly pale gray back, pale eye, and dull pinkish legs.

name: Ibisbill
rangeDescription: Rocky mountain streams and rivers of central asia
description: Expertly camouflaged amongst the fast-moving rocky rivers and streams it prefers, this specialized wader is often difficult to see. Upperparts are gray and faded brown; white belly is bound in by a black belt; a vaguely crescent-shaped black patch on the face is unique among waders.

name: Jamaican Becard
rangeDescription: Wooded hills of jamaica
description: A small but stout woodland species often found hovering beneath the canopy while snapping up insects or fruit. Note the male’s all blackish plumage.

name: Black-chested Snake-Eagle
rangeDescription: Eastern sudan and ethiopia to south africa
description: A medium-sized, mostly brown eagle with yellow eyes and an unspotted white belly. In flight it has brown-barred white wings.

name: Yellow-crowned Redstart
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Distinctive warbler endemic to Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. It has a mostly black head, yellow crown and underparts, and a buffy stripe between the eye and bill.

name: Camiguin Bulbul
rangeDescription: Camiguin sur (southern philippines)
description: A fairly large bulbul of forest and forest edge on Camiguin, where it is unmistakable. Dark olive-brown with a pale bill.
